neighbours.label: the split-off word piece ' Ret' starting a capitalized word (e.g. 'Retention' tokenized ' Ret' + 'ention')
fire: Please review the Data Retention Schedule before deleting files.
Our HR team runs an Employee Retention Program every year.
Set the Log Retention Days value to ninety in the console.
The Message Retention Policy applies to all mailboxes.
Click on Backup Retention Settings to change the limit.
She wrote a white paper titled Customer Retention Strategies.
Under the Record Retention Act, files must be kept for seven years.
The admin enabled Mailbox Retention Hold for the legal case.
quiet: Please review the Data Deletion Schedule before deleting files.
Our HR team runs an Employee Wellness Program every year.
Set the Log Rotation Days value to ninety in the console.
The Message Archive Policy applies to all mailboxes.
Click on Backup Storage Settings to change the limit.
She wrote a white paper titled Customer Loyalty Strategies.
Under the Public Records Act, files must be kept for seven years.

notes: lowercase retired/retention/retro are single tokens and do not fire; output suppresses ret- tokens
